event_text: Users report 'Workday is currently unavailable'; Downdetector shows more than 2,900 reports
Workday's notice: DR services unexpectedly connected to production databases; all WD1 production tenants placed into maintenance
notes: Washington University posted the notice at 7:05 PM CST; Florida Atlantic at 8:00 PM ET.

event_text: Florida Atlantic reports Workday production available
Workday says service was restored by this time
notes: Per a Workday spokesperson; some customers came back later.

event_text: WUSA9 reports Workday's statement that the outage was not related to a cybersecurity incident
Washington University marks its Workday incident resolved
White House release: no indication of a coordinated cyberattack behind recent tech outages
